scope: Verify overwrite authority for legacy positional and FreeCAD-compatible -o conversion routes across prompt refusal, noninteractive refusal and explicit ASCII/Binary replacement.

control.runtimeAuthoredInput: A minimal AC1021 DXF is written from SOURCE bytes in a temporary directory; destination contents use the local SENTINEL bytes. No fixture is committed.

cases.result: stdin is EOF under run_bounded; the prompt appears, conversion cancels, and source/destination bytes remain unchanged
noninteractive refusal without prompt; source/destination bytes remain unchanged
each token replaces the sentinel with AC1021 output in ASCII and Binary; source remains unchanged

validation.build: PASS: dwg2dxf executable from cmake --build build-gcc --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip -j2
validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --options-only (103 controls); ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_contract$' --output-on-failure (1/1, 9.63 s)

limits: The legacy prompt control verifies the safe EOF-cancel path; the explicit -y/-Y bypass path verifies successful replacement. It does not simulate typed interactive Y/N input.
